content:
maria-nguyen: Heads-up — proposing to remove header-based route lookup (X-Model-Version) in favor of an explicit `api-version` header and URL route param. Need to align on rollout UX, quota implications, and telemetry.

alex-r: +1 on the move. Console + migration docs will be critical. Do we have an estimate of how many callers still use X-Model-Version?

sanjay: Telemetry: ~1.8% of requests in prod-us are still using X-Model-Version, mostly SDK <= 0.9.4. Those create many route permutations which inflate quota dimensions.

laura-product: From PM side: we need a visible migration path in Console — banner, per-org migration status, and a small canary opt-in. Also want predicted billing/quota delta for affected orgs.

maria-nguyen: Proposed rollout:
1) Add `api-version` as the preferred header in vnext.
2) Accept legacy `X-Model-Version` for 90 days but emit a response warning header.
3) Offer gateway-level automatic rewrite for flagged orgs for 30 days (opt-in).
4) After the grace period, return 400 with migration link for legacy header usage.

alex-r: Sounds good. Telemetry needs: legacy_header_pct, rewrite_hits, and mapping fidelity metric. Rollback policy: if errors or regressions > 0.5% we flip gateway to model-compat fallback.

sanjay: I'll add metrics and a dashboard. Plan to tag metrics with account_id, sdk_version, and route_key. Also exposing quota-dimension-count so billing can simulate the delta.

deploy-bot: deploy started: header-migration-gateway v1.2 -> canary on prod-us-1 :rocket:

laura-product: UX notes: Console should show per-org: current header usage, suggested action (upgrade SDK / enable shim), and an estimate of quota change. A per-org 'compatibility shim' toggle would make migration smoother.

maria-nguyen: +1 on shim toggle. Need to loop in pricing/ops — some orgs will see higher quota usage because explicit routing collapses fewer requests into one bucket. @laura-product can you get PO to sign off on billing impact comms?

alex-r: example client + response warning: 
```
# client request
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Model-Version: redwood-v1" https://api.redwood.ai/generate

# response headers while shim active
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Redwood-Warning: Deprecated header X-Model-Version used; please switch to Api-Version header.
```

sanjay: Also adding alerting: if rewrite_hits spikes and p50 latency > 100ms for 5m, page eng-oncall. Will include a dashboard tile for "legacy header heatmap" and top callers.

maria-nguyen: Timeline: announce 2025-06-01 (console banner + docs), soft-accept legacy + shim for 90 days, enforce reject 2025-08-30. Please surface objections now; will close plan EOD Friday. :pray:
